title: Z.AI open sources its coding harness ZCode and disables certain features after users said ZCode was uploading codebases onto overseas servers without consent (Laurie Chen/Reuters)
summary: Laurie Chen / Reuters: Z.AI open sources its coding harness ZCode and disables certain features after users said ZCode was uploading codebases onto overseas servers without consent — Chinese startup Z.ai said on Monday it had disabled some features of its flagship AI coding assistant after some users reported …
